objective: Rename Marites Story to Today's Best, relocate the story strip to the start of the Wall just below the title bar and before search/Notes, and modestly enlarge the cards and heading.

chosenApproach: Reuse existing single BuklodMaritesBoard mount and media/visibility hooks, place it before the native search/Notes rail; reorder the web wrapper likewise; adjust shared story dimensions from 132x178 to 148x200 dp and title font from 12 to 16; rename user-visible story strings without changing backend marker, auth or model.

Keep stories after the manuscript and link from the top, rejected because it does not meet immediate top placement.
